sources.title: 7 Solo Founders Building $1M+ AI Businesses in 2026
sources.snippet: A full solopreneur tech stack in 2026 costs between $3,000 and $12,000 per year, a 95-98% reduction compared to traditional staffing, enabling operating margins of 60-80%. As of early 2026, 38% of seven-figure businesses are led by solopreneurs who replaced traditional hires with AI-powered workflows.
